headline: UPDATE to totw-20261023-1800-01 (Oleshky localized ceasefire) -- CONFIRMATION GAP CLOSED
dek: Both Russia and Ukraine now confirm the Oleshky localized ceasefire. Gerasimov ordered Russian troops to halt fire from 01:00 GMT Oct 27 (4am local).
sources: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov (on-record, via Reuters); Gen. Valery Gerasimov (Russian Defence Ministry channel, MAX/Telegram); Ukrainian General Staff (statement); White House statement (Oct 23, primary); Dmytro Lubin
fault_line: Real humanitarian breakthrough brokered by a First Lady -- or announcement-first diplomacy: will the guns actually go quiet at 01:00 GMT on Oct 27?

sections.what_happened: Both Russia and Ukraine now confirm the Oleshky localized ceasefire. Gerasimov ordered Russian troops to halt fire from 01:00 GMT Oct 27 (4am local). Ukraine's General Staff issued a matching statement: ceasefire regime from 03:00 Kyiv Oct 27 to conduct a humanitarian operation; pledges 'everything possible to help Oleshky's residents'. Peskov: civilians who want to leave will be allowed; evacuation takes several days; Putin and Trump discussed it by phone. Lubinets (to Reuters): operation = demining roads to the town, food deliveries, civilian evacuations. Melania Trump: 'The situation in Oleshky is dire.' Pope Leo XIV spoke to both Putin (from hospital) and Zelensky about Oleshky. CONFLICT: White House said the pause begins Oct 29; both militaries now say Oct 27. Neither statement names a duration or the exact territory. Ukraine says it already delivered food twice by drone.
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire (Kremlin confirmation + Peskov quotes); Al Jazeera (separate T2/state-flagged reporting, incl. 'Musk restored Starlink' sidebar); Yonhap wire; Dawn (T3); NDTV (T3). Straits Times carries the same facts (wire-carry ambiguity per registry -- counted with the wire's family in family_count, not separately). Ukraine General Staff + Gerasimov are primary sources of their own orders.
sections.what_disputed: Date clash: White House (Oct 23) said Oct 29; both militaries say Oct 27 -- Oct 29 may reflect the earlier announcement or a second phase. Neither statement defines the ceasefire's duration or the exact designated area. No named monitoring/enforcement mechanism. Social reaction remains polarized: Melania's own IG post (verified, 4.7M followers) 11K likes / 1.1K comments with heavy skepticism ('satire? is it real?'); Fox News reel 13K likes / 1.3K comments.
sections.why_matters: The confirmation gap is closed: Moscow AND Kyiv both say the guns stop Oct 27. But the White House said Oct 29 -- and nobody has named how long it lasts, exactly where it applies, or who watches it. The first ceasefire of the war, with the fine print still missing.
